phrase.en: AI accounts spread dubious health advice
phrase.zh: AI账号传播可疑健康建议

phrase.en: AI virtual patient for breaking bad news
phrase.zh: AI虚拟病人用于告知坏消息

gloss.en: AI-generated doctors dispense dangerous health advice on TikTok, while virtual patients train doctors in breaking bad news.
gloss.zh: AI生成的医生在TikTok传播危险健康建议，而虚拟病人却用于培训医生告知坏消息。

why_now.en: You care about LLM and AI: today's research shows both the peril and promise of AI in healthcare—misinformation vs. training.
why_now.zh: 你关注LLM和AI：今天的研究同时展示了AI在医疗中的危险与希望——虚假信息与培训。

phrase.en: US pauses strikes, military advises stop
phrase.zh: 美军暂停打击，军方建议停止

gloss.en: US pauses strikes on Iran after military advises halt, oil prices fall as fighting pauses.
gloss.zh: 美军在军方建议停止后暂停对伊朗打击，油价因停火而下跌。

why_now.en: You track geopolitics: today the US-Iran de-escalation shifts energy markets and global security.
why_now.zh: 你关注地缘政治：今日美伊局势降级影响能源市场和全球安全。

phrase.en: PM pledges Ukraine support before Zelensky visit
phrase.zh: 首相承诺支持乌克兰，泽连斯基将访

phrase.en: Burnham vows to fix social care
phrase.zh: 伯纳姆誓言修复社会护理

phrase.en: Burnham to meet Zelenskyy at naval base
phrase.zh: 伯纳姆将在海军基地会晤泽连斯基

gloss.en: New PM Burnham supports Ukraine and vows to fix social care, marking a shift in UK priorities.
gloss.zh: 新首相伯纳姆支持乌克兰并誓言修复社会护理，标志英国优先事项转变。

why_now.en: You follow HCI and technical communication: policy changes affect research funding and public service design.
why_now.zh: 你关注人机交互和技术传播：政策变化影响研究经费和公共服务设计。
